name: harness-marketplace
description: Governed harness engineering for AI agents: scaffold, audit, verify and red-team, on any framework.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: Resume and checkpoint skills (checkpoint records evidence with harness verify), a Haiku explore agent, a Sonnet verifier, and a hook that shows only failing test output.

plugins.name: harness-init
plugins.description: Scaffold a governed harness: work list with executable done_when checks, a hash-chained ledger that binds approved criteria to evidence (harness approve / verify / check), progress note, decisions log, clean-state checklist, init.sh, CLAUDE.md and safe settings.

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Score a repo's agent harness across 7 areas, including evidence binding and real-path red teaming, with file:line evidence for every pass and a fix for every gap.

plugins.name: harness-redteam
plugins.description: Red-team your agent two ways: promptfoo and DeepTeam evals mapped to OWASP, and a live harness that runs attacks through the real tool path with canaries, a tool trace, an egress log and action-based verdicts.
